name: dj-librarian
description: A DJ librarian for rekordbox you talk to through Claude. Syncs Spotify inboxes into crates, builds playlist trees and tidies tags. Create and add only, dry-run first, nothing written without your yes.

uv_path.title: uv path
uv_path.description: The command that starts the engine. Leave it as uv; on a Mac where Claude cannot find uv, put the full path that `command -v uv` prints in Terminal.
